decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the boundary hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition of construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am and 6pm on Mondays to Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 5 - Within one planting season of the removal of these trees, a total of 9 replacement trees (Acer platanoides (Norway Maple), Prunus pructicosa "Globosa" (Dwarf Cherry), Tilia mongolica (Mongolian Lime) and Syringa reticulate (Japanese Tree Lilac) should be replanted within the specified locations. The trees should be 4-5 metres in height, with a trunk diameter of 14-18cms. The replacement trees shall be maintained in perpetuity. Should the replacement tree die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then a further replacement tree to the same specification shall be planted immediately.

Condition : 6 - Prior to commencement on site, a detailed Arboricultural Method Statement (regarding the preservation of the existing street trees) should be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Details of any exterior lighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of work, and the details shall be carried out as approved.
description: Replacement of existing fence along Harvard Road with brick boundary with open railings, including two gates and pedestrian access to site, removal of 12 trees and replanting with 9 new trees and yew hedge
